skill.name: imagegen-frontend-web
skill.description: Generates premium frontend website reference images, with one horizontal image per section. It guides composition, palette, hero scale, imagery, spacing, and conversion flow for landing pages and product sites.
skill.summary: Generate premium, section-by-section frontend website reference images.

content.value_statement: Frontend image prompts often produce repetitive layouts. This skill directs Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward distinct, section-by-section website reference images.
actual_capabilities: Generates one horizontal image per requested website section.
Defaults ambiguous landing pages to six sections and full websites to eight sections.
Chooses hero scale, composition anchors, background modes, CTA styles, and palette rules.
Applies checks against repeated layouts, generic dashboards, weak typography, and stock-like imagery.
Maintains one brand world across multi-section image sets.
limitations: It provides image direction and generated visuals, not production frontend code.
Long websites may require many image generations, which can increase time and cost.
Visual quality depends on the image model and the clarity of the user brief.
It cannot verify exact implementation details unless the user supplies generated images for review.

use_cases.title: Create Landing Page Concepts
use_cases.description: Create image-led landing page references that keep sections consistent while avoiding repeated template blocks.

use_cases.title: Direct Product Website Art
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into section images with clear hierarchy, CTA priority, and buildable layout cues.

use_cases.title: Guide Frontend Implementation
use_cases.description: Give developers visual section references for spacing, imagery, typography, rhythm, and responsive intent.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Hero Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need one strong first viewport.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one premium hero section image for a modern SaaS product. Use a non-default composition and clear CTA priority.

prompt_templates.title: Landing Page Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a complete small site direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate six horizontal images for a landing page. Keep one brand world and vary composition across each section.

prompt_templates.title: Product Site Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a product needs premium but practical references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create eight website section images for a fintech product. Use product-led imagery, restrained proof, and clear conversion flow.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Creative System
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need strong art direction across many sections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design twelve horizontal section images for a creative studio site. Use one palette, varied anchors, and a visible narrative concept.

output_examples.input: Generate a landing page for a privacy-focused analytics tool.
output_examples.output: The skill returns six labeled horizontal section images with varied hero, feature, proof, pricing, FAQ, and CTA treatments.

output_examples.input: Create a hero section for a luxury travel brand.
output_examples.output: The skill produces one cinematic horizontal hero reference with premium typography, strong imagery, and a readable CTA area.

output_examples.input: Design eight sections for a fintech website.
output_examples.output: The skill creates eight separate images that share palette, typography, CTA language, spacing, and trust-focused visual rhythm.

best_practices: State the site type, audience, brand mood, and primary conversion goal.
Specify the desired section count when you need an exact image set.
Provide brand colors, product screenshots, or image references when consistency matters.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full website if you only need one hero image.
Do not request many unrelated visual styles in one multi-section set.
Do not use vague briefs when brand tone, audience, or product category matters.

faq.question: Does this skill create frontend code?
faq.answer: No. It creates visual references and art direction for frontend designs.

faq.question: How many images does it generate for a landing page?
faq.answer: If no count is given, it defaults to six horizontal section images.

faq.question: Can I request a single hero image?
faq.answer: Yes. A hero request produces one horizontal image focused on the first viewport.

faq.question: Will every section look the same?
faq.answer: No. The skill varies composition, background mode, density, and CTA treatment across sections.

faq.question: Is it suitable for product and SaaS websites?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes product framing, proof sections, CTA hierarchy, and implementation-friendly layout cues.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing brand direction?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide palette, tone, imagery, and section goals for stronger consistency.
